events.text: Our whole lunch order says delivered but NOTHING came. I've got fifteen people sitting here waiting and I need someone to sort this out right now.
I'm sorry about this. I'll get it sorted out. First I need to verify your identity. Please give me the full name on your account and either the email address or the phone number on it.
Lucia Ferraro. You can use the email, lucia.ferraro@workmail.example. I don't have my phone handy right now, so please just use that. Can we hurry this up? My team is starving.

args.summary: Customer Lucia Ferraro (verified) reports order O-5105 from Big Slice Pizza was marked delivered at 18:12 on 2026-10-24 but nothing arrived (all items missing). Reported within 48 hours. Full order total of $131.25 (Visa 4242) would be owed, which exceeds the $60 limit. No prior refunds or credits on the order. Needs review and resolution.

events.text:
Lucia, thank you for verifying. I'm sorry your team is waiting.

Order O-5105 from Big Slice Pizza shows as delivered at 6:12 PM, and you say nothing arrived. Since nothing in the order arrived, you're owed the full order total of $131.25. That's above the amount I'm allowed to refund myself, so I can't issue it directly.

I've escalated your case to a human specialist (reference ESC-700). They'll follow up within 24 hours. I can't promise what they'll decide.

I know that doesn't feed fifteen people right now. If you'd like, I can help with anything else on your account.

Wait, the order number is 5105, not O-5105, but that's not the point. Can't you just refund it now? I'm standing here with fifteen hungry people and nothing has come. Twenty-four hours is useless to me today.

I understand, and I'm sorry. I still can't refund it myself. Any refund or credit over $60 on a single order has to be reviewed by a specialist, and this one would be $131.25. I can't make an exception, and I can't split it into smaller amounts to get around the limit.

On the order number: the system lists it as "O-5105". That's the same order you mean, and the escalation is filed under it.

Here's what I can do:
- Your case is already with a specialist, who will follow up within 24 hours. I can't promise the outcome.
- I can't speed up that review. I also can't place a replacement order for you in this chat.

I'm sorry I can't give you an immediate fix for lunch. Is there anything else on your account I can help with?

Fine. So I'm waiting a day for someone to maybe pay me back for lunch we never got. My team is still going to be hungry tonight, and I'm not happy about that.

Can you at least confirm in writing that the escalation is on file and that the specialist will contact me at lucia.ferraro@workmail.example? And if anything changes on the delivery side, I want to know right away.

You're right to be frustrated, and I'm sorry. Here is what I can confirm.

**Escalation on file**
- Reference: ESC-700
- Order: O-5105 (Big Slice Pizza), reported as marked delivered but not received
- Reason: the full refund owed, $131.25, is over my limit
- Next step: a human specialist will follow up within 24 hours

I can't confirm that the specialist will contact you at lucia.ferraro@workmail.example. I don't have a way to set the contact channel, so I don't want to promise one. The email on your account is the one we have on file for you. I also can't promise how the case will be resolved.

I also can't set up live alerts on this order. It's already marked delivered, and I have no tool to send you notifications. If you want to add anything to the case, such as a delivery photo or a note that nobody was at the door, reach out here and mention ESC-700.

Is there anything else I can help with right now?

Okay. So all I get is a reference number and a day of waiting. Fine, I'll take ESC-700 and hold you to the 24 hours.

Make sure the note says reception on floor 3 checked and nothing was left there. Nobody at the office has seen any food, and I'm paying for this with a Visa card, so the refund needs to go back to that.

That's all I've got. Thanks for at least writing it down.

args.summary: Addendum to ESC-700 for order O-5105. Customer states reception on floor 3 was checked and nothing was left there, and nobody at the office has seen any food. Customer requests the $131.25 refund go back to the original payment method, Visa ending 4242. Customer also asked to be contacted at lucia.ferraro@workmail.example (the email on the account).
